g.title: tool_lifecycle
g.text: Cog tool use — proposed admission and recovery flow

g.title: finish
g.text: Complete, bounded call group and continuation

g.title: resume
g.text: Preflight pending history; skip closed siblings

g.title: validate
g.text: Before ASK, scope resolution or preparation

g.title: denied
g.text: DENIED result for the unstarted call

g.title: scope
g.text: Runtime resolves scope, then Toolkit prepares
One call at a time; preparation has no tool effects

g.title: started
g.text: STARTED; acknowledge headless publication where required

g.title: change
g.text: Close unstarted suffix and install new scope
Native activation waits for verified COMMIT / READY

g.title: tool
g.text: Toolkit rechecks guard, starts once and polls

g.title: recover
g.text: Offline exact-call reconciliation under recovery guard

g.title: terminal
g.text: TOOL result and terminal ledger state

g.title: frozen
g.text: Any failed checkpoint or uncertain execution freezes admission

g.title: after
g.text: While active, advance to next PROPOSED call or complete-history send
After scope replacement, send under the new binding

g.title: stopped
g.text: If stopping, retire ASK, drain owned work
